events.outcome: inbound verification SMS worked while outgoing SMS/voice/Wi-Fi Calling were initially incomplete or conflicting

kyc.label: No universal passport rule established; eSIM account/email required
kyc.note: Official pages reviewed do not establish a universal passport/identity-document requirement for PAYG. Lebara does require an account and valid verified email for eSIM purchase.

roamingSms.label: International roaming SMS supported after UK activation
roamingSms.note: Lebara supports roaming and states incoming texts are free in documented roaming scenarios. The SIM must first be activated in the UK; outside included regions PAYG credit or an add-on may be needed for outgoing usage.

wifiCallingAbroad.label: Wi-Fi Calling abroad not yet proven
wifiCallingAbroad.note: Lebara documents Wi-Fi Calling support on compatible eSIM devices, but the MVP does not yet have explicit official evidence that overseas Wi-Fi Calling can be relied on for SMS/OTP recovery.

data.acquisitionSummary: Direct Lebara eSIM acquired from China; one recent flow reported ~£1.5 promotional first-month plan plus £5 credit/top-up.

keep.action: Generate confirmed chargeable activity and verify it appears in usage history; one account/support interaction confirmed a 90-day reset.

data.chinaActivation: inbound SMS reproduced after direct install in mainland China without prior UK-network attachment; full outgoing voice/SMS state may remain incomplete until UK attachment
data.kyc: not fully normalized in this packet
data.payment: direct purchase/top-up reproduced; exact current payment methods need refresh
data.roamingSms: inbound SMS reproduced in mainland China
data.refund: at least one refund after setup/service trouble reported; no rate
data.tariffSummary: Recent community flow used a ~£1.5 first-month offer plus £5 credit; promo price must be refreshed before purchase.
guideSteps: Open the current direct Lebara UK eSIM offer and recheck the live first-month price before paying.
Install the eSIM and confirm the line receives Lebara system/inbound SMS before binding an important account.
Test the exact app you need; current mainland-China reports cover inbound WhatsApp and Telegram codes, not a universal OTP guarantee.
For retention, generate a real chargeable activity and confirm it appears in account usage; one recent account/support interaction used a 90-day window with a 70–75 day practical buffer.

data.caveat: Low keep-alive cost, but the line must be activated in the UK first.
data.kyc: no universal passport rule; account/email for eSIM

data.summary: Lebara states that its SIM/eSIM must be activated in the UK before it is taken abroad; an eSIM can be ordered while outside the UK but must still be activated in the UK.
data.outsideHomeNote: If you are outside the UK now, you can research or order the route, but do not treat it as immediately usable until you can activate it in the UK.

data.inactivity_window: After 90 days with no call, text or mobile-data use, service is temporarily barred. After a further 365 days with no usage or top-up/plan purchase, the SIM expires.
data.clock_start_or_reset: The first 90-day clock is defined by the last documented call, text or data use. After temporary barring, adding credit or buying a plan restores service. The official help page does not explicitly say that a top-up made before day 90 by itself resets the initial usage clock.
qualifying_activity: After temporary barring, add credit or buy a plan to resume service.
non_qualifying_or_unknown_activity: Incoming SMS is not listed as qualifying use.
Account login and balance checks are not listed as qualifying use.
A pre-bar top-up as a substitute for call/text/data activity is not explicit in the cited official help rule.
data.lowest_cost_documented_action: Send one standard UK PAYG SMS while the line is active. Current official UK rate: £0.19 per text. Data is charged per KB and could cost less, but the official page does not document a minimum billable data session, so it is not used as the fixed-cost baseline.
data.safest_documented_action: Before 90 days, complete a normal chargeable call, SMS or data session. If the SIM has already been temporarily barred, add credit or buy a plan through Lebara to restore service.

minimum_expected_cost.note: Roaming rates can differ by destination.

recommended_buffer.basis: Product-side buffer only; Lebara’s provider deadline remains 90 days.

data.grace_or_rescue_window: Temporary barring after 90 days is followed by a further 365-day recoverable inactivity period; adding credit or buying a plan can restore service during that period.
data.termination_and_recycling: After the further 365-day period, Lebara says the SIM expires and a new SIM/number is required. The cited official page does not state the exact number-recycling timing.

reminder.anchor_label: Last call, text or mobile-data use date
reminder.anchor_help: Use the last documented usage date that starts Lebara’s initial 90-day inactivity clock. Do not substitute a pre-bar top-up unless Lebara documents it for your plan.
reminder.summary: Use the Lebara line before temporary barring
reminder.description: Complete a normal documented call, text or data session before the 90-day inactivity boundary. The calendar event is placed 14 days early as a product-side buffer.
